note: Hypothetical requirement changes for demonstrating change impact. None of these has been announced by FIFA; each changes one criterion of a register check so its effect on existing evidence can be shown.

scenarios.title: Larger mixed zone
scenarios.summary: The mixed zone grows from at least 200 m² to at least 250 m², for more broadcasters and written press.

scenarios.title: Bigger team dressing rooms
scenarios.summary: Team dressing rooms grow from at least 80 m² to at least 100 m².

scenarios.title: Longer back-up power
scenarios.summary: Back-up power must run for at least four hours during an outage instead of three.
